# 3webs

> 3webs is a 167-signal AI-visibility engine, operated by AIVENTURE S.R.L. It observes a submitted URL across three webs — the human web (SEO), the AI web (AEO, GEO, AIO) and the machine web (AI Signals, A2A) — and returns a deterministic, evidence-based report with a prioritised action plan. No score is generated by a language model; every verdict traces to a fetched, publicly-served resource.

3webs is built for two audiences at once: people who want to know how their site reads to AI systems, and AI agents that want to call the engine directly over A2A (JSON-RPC 2.0) to audit a URL, list the signal catalogue, or diff two observations.

## Core pages

- [Home / run an audit](https://3webobs.com/): submit a URL and get the full report
- [The 167 signals](https://3webobs.com/#criteria): what is measured, grouped by dimension
- [FAQ](https://3webobs.com/#faq): what the audit measures, how scoring works, what it does not claim
- [Contact](https://3webobs.com/contact.html): company identity, contact routes, agent documentation

## Machine-readable resources

- [Agent card](https://3webobs.com/.well-known/agent-card.json): A2A v1.0 discovery document
- [Capabilities](https://3webobs.com/capabilities.json): declared skills, contracts, pricing
- [Signal registry](https://3webobs.com/signals.json): the full 167-signal catalogue with weights
- [Identity declaration](https://3webobs.com/ai.json): machine-readable entity identity
- [Governance](https://3webobs.com/governance.json): AI governance declaration
- [Integrity manifest](https://3webobs.com/proof.json): SHA-256 hashes of public evidence files

## Notes for crawlers and agents

This file is for guidance, not a sitemap — see [sitemap.xml](https://3webobs.com/sitemap.xml) for the full crawlable URL list. Training and reuse permissions are declared in [ai.txt](https://3webobs.com/ai.txt). The audit endpoint (`POST /audit`) and the A2A endpoint (`POST /a2a`) only ever fetch publicly served resources on the submitted domain — no authentication is attempted and nothing is installed.
